# Xplania — full description

> Xplania (https://xplania.app) is a web AI travel companion, available in French and English. It helps travelers plan, budget, pack, handle formalities, track and remember their trips. All AI advice is specific to the destination (real places, prices, local words), never generic.

## Features

- Traveler profile quiz (/): swipe cards about travel preferences; you get a traveler badge, reward points and two recommended tools.
- Trip planner (/dashboard): multi-step form (destination, dates, budget, travel style, companions) that produces personalized recommendations.
- Budget guide (/guide-budget): realistic per-day budget, manual expense tracking with charts, live currency converter, AI alerts and saving tips, PDF export.
- Packing guide (/guide-valise): packing checklist adapted to destination, weather, luggage type (cabin, checked, backpack) and activities; outfit ideas and cultural tips.
- Visa & vaccines guide (/guide-visa): visa formalities, recommended vaccines and safety advice, summarized from official sources (France Diplomatie, Institut Pasteur, WHO). Always check official sites before travelling.
- Mood Explorer (/mood): place recommendations based on your current mood, with map and badges.
- Discover (/discover): local places from OpenStreetMap enriched by AI, natural-language search, saved lists.
- Hidden gems (/hidden-gems) and destinations (/destinations): lesser-known destinations matching your profile.
- Live trip tracking (/suivi): map, timeline, check-ins, weather and suggestions; optional public share link.
- Travel journal / Carnet (/carnet): day-by-day notes, photos, moods and places, AI-written trip story, PDF export and optional public page.
- Gamification: XP, levels, weekly missions, streaks and badges.

## Pricing

- Free: 3 free AI generations per tool, no card required.
- Premium packs: planned for public launch (late 2026 / early 2027). Waitlist on /offres.

## Privacy

EU hosting, no resale of data, sharing is opt-in, account and data can be deleted anytime. Details on /trust and /privacy-policy.
